official_sources_checked.name: T-Rex
official_sources_checked.role: primary tactile-reactive policy architecture and checkpoint reference

released_checkpoints.name: miniFranka/T-Rex_pretrain_mecka22k_epoch1
released_checkpoints.claim: VLM-action alignment on about 22k tactile-free episodes; action and latent experts

released_checkpoints.name: miniFranka/T-Rex_midtrain_mecka23k_ucb100_vqvae_epoch6
released_checkpoints.claim: tactile-reactive cascaded flow with embedded temporal tactile VQ-VAE; recommended starting checkpoint for post-training

dataset.name: zekaiwang/trex_dataset
dataset.public_scale: about 50 hours, about 5.4k trajectories, 5.47M frames exposed in HF viewer
tactile_fields: 10 per-fingertip tactile streams in official README
deformation maps and estimated 6D wrenches in official README

official_sources_checked.why_not_promoted: T-Rex is bimanual Dexmate/Sharpa Wave with 10 fingertip tactile sensors and eef-62 data; current Newton Panda evidence is single-arm and candidate/proxy tactile. Gate 00F official tactile semantic validation is still open.

official_sources_checked.name: FTP-1
official_sources_checked.checkpoint_claim: 4B-parameter pretrained checkpoint, 50k steps, image/state/language/optional tactile input, action chunk output
official_sources_checked.why_not_promoted: FTP-1 is a serious future baseline but is not Newton-native base grasp evidence and does not clear Gate 00F tactile semantic validation.

official_sources_checked.name: AnyTouch2
official_sources_checked.role: future tactile representation and force-aware dynamic perception reference
official_sources_checked.dataset_claim: ToucHD-Force contains 722,436 touch-force pairs and belongs to a 2,426,174-contact-sample tactile hierarchy dataset
official_sources_checked.why_not_promoted: AnyTouch2 is representation learning, not a complete Newton base controller; access/download and official sanity are still not run.

official_sources_checked.name: Sparsh
official_sources_checked.role: additional serious tactile representation and force-field decoder reference
official_sources_checked.checkpoint_status: pretrained backbones and force-field decoder checkpoints are available on Hugging Face per official README
official_sources_checked.why_not_promoted: Useful for later tactile encoder/force-field comparisons, but not a Newton simulator/base-model gate replacement.

current_decision.base_model: Newton d58 remains the current strongest runtime-positive candidate evidence chain, not T-Rex/FTP-1/AnyTouch2
future_policy_priority_after_gate00f: Use T-Rex midtrain checkpoint as the strongest tactile-reactive architecture reference if a faithful Newton-to-T-Rex data contract can be built.
Use FTP-1 4B checkpoint as a serious general tactile policy baseline/reference after dense tactile/base gates pass.
Use AnyTouch2 or Sparsh as tactile representation/force-field baselines, not as controller completion evidence.
